defect: SPI input is read through a statically out-of-range bit index
rationale: flash_io_i is declared with bits 7 through 0, but the datapath selects bit 8, so the SPI sample is not connected to a real input bit.

mutation.description: Changed the SPI input sample index from an existing bit to the constant index 8.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the SPI memory interface to an eight-bit input sampling path.

labels.note: constant index 8 out of range of [7:0]
